A1181.amendmentNote: A1181 replaced A1180 effective 1 January 2025. Covers all wastes having as constituents or contaminants lead, copper compounds, cadmium, antimony, beryllium, arsenic, or selenium. Any legacy references to A1180 in existing permits or contracts must be updated to A1181.
misclassifications: Classifying tested-working assemblies as A1181 when B1110 may apply — document functional testing rigorously
Using legacy code A1180 after January 2025 — all permits and movement documents must now reference A1181
Treating mixed shipments containing even one hazardous unit as B1110 — the entire consignment defaults to A1181
documents: PIC consent from destination Competent Authority
Recovery or disposal facility permit (Annex IV operation)
Movement document (accompanies waste at all times)

A1170.fullName: Unsorted hazardous waste batteries / hazardous waste batteries not specified on list B — Annex VIII (A1170)
misclassifications: Treating every waste lithium battery automatically as A1170 without checking composition, specification and applicable national controls.

Y31.fullName: Wastes having lead; lead compounds as constituents — Annex I (Y31)
misclassifications: Treating Y31 itself as the Annex VIII list entry for waste lead-acid batteries — use A1160 for waste lead-acid batteries.
documents: Use with the applicable Annex VIII/II entry and Annex III hazardous characteristics as relevant.

misclassifications: Mixing Y31 and Y32 codes without distinguishing whole batteries from scrap plate/paste
Treating scrap lead plates as non-hazardous metal scrap — Basel Annex II applies

B1110.fullName: Deleted e-waste entry B1110 — not current after 31 December 2024
B1110.annexType: Deleted from Annex IX effective 1 January 2025
B1110.amendmentNote: BC-15/18 deleted B1110 effective 1 January 2025. Current e-waste uses A1181 or Y49 when the material is waste; used equipment claimed as non-waste requires a separate waste/non-waste determination.
misclassifications: Using B1110 on post-2024 Basel e-waste movements.

B1120.fullName: Spent catalysts excluding liquids used as catalysts — Annex IX (B1120)
misclassifications: Using B1120 for batteries — B1120 is a spent-catalyst entry.

B3011.amendmentNote: B3011 is the Annex IX entry for certain plastic wastes meeting its conditions. OECD members may apply national controls; do not infer a universal PIC rule from OECD/non-OECD status alone.
misclassifications: Applying B3011 without confirming that all entry conditions are met
Assuming one universal OECD control procedure — national controls may differ

A3210.fullName: Plastic waste containing/contaminated with Annex I constituents to an extent that it exhibits an Annex III characteristic — Annex VIII (A3210)
misclassifications: Assigning A3210 solely because plastic is mixed or e-waste-derived without evidence that the entry criteria are met.
documents: Full chemical analysis (brominated compounds, PFAS, heavy metals)

Defaulting to non-hazardous without testing — always apply the precautionary principle and test

Hold shipment until classification is confirmed
